name: flybnb-battery
note: indices are rows of the payload's neuron table (the same for the >=5 and the >=2 synapse export); root ids are FlyWire v783

stimuli.name: sound
stimuli.rule: Johnston's organ A and B neurons of both antennae that have outgoing connections of >= 5 synapses (the set of the network's first task, tasks/flywire-gate: joLR)

stimuli.name: sound_left
stimuli.rule: the same, left antenna only: a lateralised input

stimuli.name: sound_gate
stimuli.rule: sound plus the two AN_multi_8 gate neurons. Not purely sensory: it is the first entry of the perturbation atlas (the gate silences DNge145), kept in the battery so that every individual has it

stimuli.name: head_bristle
stimuli.rule: cell_sub_class == 'head bristle' (the input of head grooming)

stimuli.name: ocelli
stimuli.rule: cell_sub_class == 'ocellar' (ocellar photoreceptors: a whole-field light step)
